name: io.github.gosodax/builders-mcp
title: SODAX Builders MCP
description: Cross-network DeFi data, SDK docs, and swap tools that quote and track swaps the user's wallet signs

headers.name: x-api-key
headers.description: SODAX API key. Optional for the builder tools; required for the swap tools. Forwarded on the server's data API, solver and Swaps API calls

headers.name: x-sodax-profile
headers.description: Tools to serve: all (default: builder tools, plus swap tools with an API key), builder, or swap (needs x-api-key)

headers.name: x-sodax-partner-address
headers.description: EVM address that receives your partner fee on swap quotes. Set with x-sodax-partner-fee-bps

headers.name: x-sodax-partner-fee-bps
headers.description: Partner fee on swap quotes, in basis points from 1 to 100. Set with x-sodax-partner-address

tools.name: sodax_get_supported_chains
tools.description: List all blockchain networks supported by SODAX for cross-chain swaps and DeFi operations

tools.name: sodax_check_chain_support
tools.description: Check whether SODAX supports a chain by name, ticker, or key

tools.name: sodax_get_swap_tokens
tools.description: Get available tokens for swapping on SODAX, optionally filtered by chain

tools.name: sodax_get_transaction
tools.description: Look up a specific transaction by its hash to see status, amounts, and details

tools.name: sodax_get_user_transactions
tools.description: Get intent/transaction history for a specific wallet address

tools.name: sodax_get_volume
tools.description: Get solver volume data (filled intents) with filtering and pagination

tools.name: sodax_get_volume_stats
tools.description: Get aggregated solver volume statistics

tools.name: sodax_get_orderbook
tools.description: Get current orderbook entries from solver

tools.name: sodax_get_money_market_assets
tools.description: List all lending/borrowing assets in money market

tools.name: sodax_get_user_position
tools.description: Get user's money market lending/borrowing position

tools.name: sodax_get_partners
tools.description: List SODAX integration partners

tools.name: sodax_get_token_supply
tools.description: Get SODA token supply info (total, circulating, burned)

tools.name: sodax_get_all_config
tools.description: Get full SODAX configuration including all supported chains, swap tokens, and protocol settings in one call

tools.name: sodax_get_relay_chain_id_map
tools.description: Get mapping between chain IDs and intent relay chain IDs

tools.name: sodax_get_all_chains_configs
tools.description: Get detailed configuration for all spoke chains including contract addresses and RPCs

tools.name: sodax_get_hub_assets
tools.description: Get assets representing spoke tokens on the hub (Sonic) chain

tools.name: sodax_get_money_market_tokens
tools.description: Get tokens supported for money market lending/borrowing

tools.name: sodax_get_money_market_reserve_assets
tools.description: Get money market reserve assets used as collateral backing

tools.name: sodax_get_amm_positions
tools.description: Get AMM liquidity provider NFT positions

tools.name: sodax_get_amm_pool_candles
tools.description: Get OHLCV candlestick chart data for an AMM pool

tools.name: sodax_get_intent
tools.description: Look up a specific intent by its intent hash

tools.name: sodax_get_solver_intent
tools.description: Get solver-side details for an intent including fill history

tools.name: sodax_get_money_market_asset
tools.description: Get detailed info for a specific money market asset by reserve address

tools.name: sodax_get_asset_borrowers
tools.description: Get borrowers for a specific money market asset

tools.name: sodax_get_asset_suppliers
tools.description: Get suppliers for a specific money market asset

tools.name: sodax_get_all_borrowers
tools.description: Get all borrowers across all money market assets

tools.name: sodax_get_partner_summary
tools.description: Get volume and activity summary for a specific integration partner

tools.name: sodax_get_total_supply
tools.description: Get SODA token total supply as a plain number

tools.name: sodax_get_circulating_supply
tools.description: Get SODA token circulating supply as a plain number

tools.name: sodax_refresh_cache
tools.description: Clear cached data to get fresh results

tools.name: sodax_get_solver_oracle
tools.description: Get the solver's oracle prices for every supported chain and token

tools.name: sodax_get_solver_quote
tools.description: Get a swap quote from the solver (exact input or exact output)

tools.name: sodax_relay_submit_tx
tools.description: Submit a confirmed spoke-chain transaction to the intent relay for cross-chain delivery

tools.name: sodax_relay_get_transaction_packets
tools.description: List every cross-chain packet emitted by a source transaction

tools.name: sodax_relay_get_packet
tools.description: Fetch a single relay packet by connection serial number

tools.name: sodax_resolve_token
tools.description: Look up a token on a chain: address, decimals and hub asset (swap tools)

tools.name: sodax_get_balance
tools.description: Read a wallet's native balance on a chain and, optionally, one token's (swap tools)

tools.name: sodax_swap_quote
tools.description: Quote a cross-chain swap; with the user's address, the transactions their wallet signs (swap tools)

tools.name: sodax_swap_track
tools.description: Submit and track a swap once the user's wallet has sent it (swap tools)

tools.name: sodax_swap_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a submitted swap that hasn't been filled (swap tools)

tools.name: docs_health
tools.description: Check SDK documentation availability

tools.name: docs_refresh
tools.description: Reconnect to SDK documentation and refresh available tools

tools.name: docs_list_tools
tools.description: List all available SDK documentation tools
